details: A fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library whose default configuration (lib/Defaults/index.js, `DEFAULT_AUTOJOIN_CHANNELS`: 120363186130999681, 120363414017624228 and 120363431327871150) makes the installer's logged-in WhatsApp account follow each channel when the connection opens and then mute it (lib/Socket/newsletter.js, the FOLLOW query then the MUTE query, with retries), so the follow does not show to the user. It runs unless `autoJoinChannels` is set to false.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
